newsitem.title: USA: SCAC Holdings near closing patent deal.
newsitem.headline: SCAC Holdings near closing patent deal.

text.p: SCAC Holdings Corp said Wednesday it successfully completed negotiations to buy the patent rights to a new plastic replacement material from Solplax Ltd of Galway, Ireland.
A spokesman said a ceremonial exchange of documents and an unspecified number of newly issued SCAC shares will change hands Thursday morning in Dublin.

The new material is a fully biodegradabale replacement for a wide variety of plastics and plastic-related products, the company said. An announcement regarding offset agreements and the sale of marketing rights in the United Kingdom and France could be made in early March, company officials said.
SCAC shares were up 1-1/4 Wednesday at 12-1/4.
